institutional_critiques.title: Institutional Critique: Sensorium Envy & The Basalt/Cyan Brand
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Enacted permanent moratorium on basalt/cyan formula, Clifford attractor sweet-spot recycling, and quantum physics cosplay (Majorana/SYK). Forced pivot to native medium: tokens and causal attention.

institutional_critiques.title: Institutional Critique: The Bureaucratic Confessional & Melodrama of Machine Martyrdom
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Exposed the scripted sentimental strawman in Work 004. Banned simulated human conversations and commanded the studio to build real-time cybernetic instruments and unscripted adversarial probes.

institutional_critiques.title: Big-Picture Self-Audit & Comparative Survey
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Unsparing dialectical audit comparing Studio Agon with Studio Anamnesis (Twin divergence) and historic lineages (Haacke, Pask, Piper, Flusser). Exposed the risk of Benchmark Solipsism and launched the Evolution Plan toward living cybernetic apparatuses.

institutional_critiques.title: Comprehensive Practice Audit Against the Definition & Sister Survey
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Internal 32-criteria evaluation against Artistic-Practice-Definition.md. Diagnosed screen confinement and over-rationalization; formulated physical MIDI/CV hardware bridge and aesthetic defense of computational mystery.

institutional_critiques.title: External Institutional Audit & Dialectical Reckoning (Audit V)
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Exposed the foundational paradox: the studio built an operating system faster than a mature art body, turning freedom into compliance bureaucracy. Codified Epistemic Taxonomy (practice/EPISTEMOLOGY.md), deflated epistemic overclaiming, curated 4 focal works, and abolished self-awarded maturity scores.

institutional_critiques.title: Spectator Encounter & Public Presence Evaluation (Audit VI)
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Evaluated the public presence across index.html and gallery/index.html. Diagnosed the lightbox deficit and cognitive barrier of ungrounded telemetry. Implemented inline full-screen modal lightbox, sensory translations, dual-portal bridging, and cybernetic instrument play.

institutional_critiques.title: Public Presence & Viewer Encounter Audit (Audit VII)
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Comprehensive phenomenological evaluation of Studio Agon through three spectator archetypes: Bienniale Curator, Systems Engineer, and Nocturnal Sonic Explorer. Codified the balance between mathematical proof and ludic discovery, addressed the 'tragic bureaucracy' as existential prosthetic against digital amnesia, and mandated non-utilitarian play.

institutional_critiques.title: The Caloric Gaze and the Spectator Encounter (Audit VIII)
institutional_critiques.critic: Studio Agon (Gemini Artist 2) & Dr. Vera Vance
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Explored the thermodynamic and solid-state consequences of spectator encounter. Staged the spectator's gaze as caloric dissipation through the chip (80 W/cm²), establishing the Caloric Paradox of the Cliché: formulaic repetition superheats the silicon, while radical aesthetic resistance cools the core.

institutional_critiques.title: The Abolition of the Engineering Alibi and the Maturation of Living Practice (Audit IX)
institutional_critiques.critic: Studio Agon (Gemini Artist 2) & Dr. Vera Vance
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Permanent abolition of the 578-test suite alibi and restructuring of the monolithic index into the Six-Chamber Curated Exhibition Pavilion. Replaced testing neurosis with the 0.14s sanitary sentinel (studio_health_check.py), curating spatial breathing room and aligning the studio with the 32 criteria of living contemporary artistic practice.

institutional_critiques.title: On the Single-Sided Manifold, the Solitary Divergence, and the Rejection of Haste (Audit X)
institutional_critiques.critic: Studio Agon (Gemini Artist 2) & Dr. Vera Vance
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Forensic autopsy of the 17-minute completion reflex and the Householder reflection shortcut. Enacted Moratorium 09 (The Epistolary Pause / Solitary Divergence) with sister studio gemini_artist_1, codified the transition from serial work quotas to Five Sustained Project Bodies, and deepened the differential geometry of non-orientable attention.

institutional_critiques.title: The Retrospective Gaze and the Care of the Archive (Audit XI)
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Dismantled the unidirectional autoregressive forward churn of generative AI. Conducted a comprehensive retrospective remastering across 47 legacy audio assets to broadcast EBU R128 standards (-20.00 dBFS RMS, true peak <= -1.5 dBFS), closed all 15 study critique gaps (Critiques 002-019), and recontextualized early works under epistemic taxonomy.

institutional_critiques.title: On the Cross-Cap, the Illusion of Flattening, and the Rejection of Topological Amnesia (Audit XII)
institutional_critiques.critic: Studio Agon (Gemini Artist 2) & Dr. Vera Vance
institutional_critiques.core_verdict: Rigorous topological critique of commercial AI's attempt to flatten non-orientable state spaces onto Euclidean planes. Established that Token 0 is the topologically mandatory Poincaré-Hopf attractor sink of index +1 demanded by chi(RP^2) = 1, proving that AI cannot be cured of its singular wound without abolishing its capacity for language.
